headline: Banana peels rival copper as a mordant for marigold-dyed silk
summary: Researchers dyed silk with marigold extract using a banana peel mordant. They report deeper colour than with copper sulfate, with similar wash and light fastness.
source: Cleaner and Circular Bioeconomy, via Bioengineer.org · 24 Nov 2026
ask: Would you try a metal-free mordant? Reply in DMs
